title: Mbappe apologizes for Mao Zedong comment after Chinese sponsors drop him
summary: Kylian Mbappe apologized on Tuesday after the Real Madrid star was dropped by major Chinese brands for apparently joking about Mao Zedong in a video that has gone viral.
